scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @cathobar/shared" "npm run dev -w @cathobar/server" "npm run dev -w @cathobar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cathobar/shared && npm run build -w @cathobar/server && npm run build -w @cathobar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cathobar/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cathobar/server && npm run typecheck -w @cathobar/web
